## Packages Published
### TypeScript (npm) - published at 21:01:19 UTC
| Package | Version | Install |
|---------|---------|--------|
| @ag-ui/langgraph | 0.0.46 | `npm install @ag-ui/langgraph@0.0.46` |

#### @ag-ui/langgraph@0.0.46

- Read LangGraph's native `Interrupt.response_schema` field (langgraph >= 1.2.12), falling back to value-level `responseSchema`/`response_schema` keys.
- Unwrap LangChain-serialized `ToolMessage` outputs under `kwargs` on tool end so tool calls and results emit correctly.
- Skip `on_tool_end` outputs with no tool call id instead of throwing or emitting events with an undefined id.
- Declare `protocolVersion` on `RUN_STARTED` events.
- Refreshed Gemini thinking demos.

##### Breaking changes

- `@ag-ui/client` and related peer dependencies now require >=1.0.0; `utils.ts` uses `contentToText`/`contentHasMedia`, which only exist in 1.0.

<!-- ag-ui-published: @ag-ui/langgraph@0.0.46 -->

detail.readme:
### The open protocol that connects any agent to any app. **[Docs](https://docs.ag-ui.com)** · **[Examples](https://dojo.ag-ui.com)** · **[Spec](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0)** · **[Discord](https://discord.gg/Jd3FzfdJa8)**

**AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.** Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid-response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG-UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi-directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack. > [!IMPORTANT] > **AG-UI 1.0 is here.** The protocol now has a stable, frozen [specification](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0) backed by a JSON Schema, and the TypeScript, Python, and .NET SDKs are generated from it. 1.0 is backwards compatible in both directions: 0.x agents work with 1.0 clients and vice versa. [What changed →](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/changelog) · [Migration guide →](https://docs.ag-ui.com/migrating-to-1-0) ## Quick start **Start a new app.** The CLI scaffolds a frontend ([CopilotKit](https://github.com/CopilotKit/CopilotKit) on Next.js, or a terminal client) wired to the agent framework you pick: ```bash npx create-ag-ui-app@latest ``` Then follow the printed next steps. The generated templates call OpenAI, so set your key before `npm run dev`: ```bash export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..." ```
Or speak the protocol directly: a 30-line agent server and client
An AG-UI agent is any HTTP endpoint that accepts a `RunAgentInput` and streams events back. No API keys needed for this one. **1. The agent (Python).** Requires Python 3.9+. ```bash pip install ag-ui-protocol fastapi uvicorn ``` ```python # server.py import uuid from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse from ag_ui.core import ( PROTOCOL_VERSION, RunAgentInput, RunStartedEvent, RunFinishedEvent, TextMessageStartEvent, TextMessageContentEvent, TextMessageEndEvent, ) from ag_ui.encoder import EventEncoder app = FastAPI() @app.post("/") async def run_agent(input_data: RunAgentInput, request: Request): encoder = EventEncoder(accept=request.headers.get("accept")) async def events(): yield encoder.encode(RunStartedEvent( thread_id=input_data.thread_id, run_id=input_data.run_id, protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION, )) message_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) yield encoder.encode(TextMessageStartEvent(message_id=message_id, role="assistant")) for chunk in ["Hello ", "from ", "AG-UI!"]: yield encoder.encode(TextMessageContentEvent(message_id=message_id, delta=chunk)) yield encoder.encode(TextMessageEndEvent(message_id=message_id)) yield encoder.encode(RunFinishedEvent(thread_id=input_data.thread_id, run_id=input_data.run_id)) return StreamingResponse(events(), media_type=encoder.get_content_type()) ``` ```bash uvicorn server:app --port 8000 ``` **2. The client (TypeScript).** In a second terminal, in a new folder. Requires Node.js 20+. ```bash npm init -y && npm pkg set type=module npm install @ag-ui/client tsx ``` ```ts // client.ts import { HttpAgent } from "@ag-ui/client"; const agent = new HttpAgent({ url: "http://localhost:8000/" }); agent.addMessage({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: "user", content: "Hi there!" }); await agent.runAgent({}, { onRunStartedEvent: ({ event }) => console.log(`run started (AG-UI ${event.protocolVersion})`), onTextMessageContentEvent: ({ event }) => { process.stdout.write(event.delta); }, onRunFinishedEvent: () => console.log("\nrun finished"), }); ``` ```bash npx tsx client.ts ``` You should see `Hello from AG-UI!` stream in. Swap the server for any [supported framework](#integrations) and the client doesn't change.
## Where AG-UI fits ![Diagram showing where AG-UI fits: a user works in your app, which connects to your agent through AG-UI (agent to user), while the agent reaches tools and data through MCP and other agents through A2A; a single agent often uses all three.](.github/readme/protocol-stack.svg) AG-UI is one of three open, complementary agentic protocols. **MCP** gives agents tools and context, **A2A** lets agents work with other agents, and **AG-UI** brings agents to users. A single agent often uses all three, and AG-UI can front agents that speak MCP or A2A. [Read more →](https://docs.ag-ui.com/agentic-protocols) > [!NOTE] > **AG-UI or A2UI?** They work together. [A2UI](https://github.com/google/A2UI), MCP Apps, and Open-JSON-UI are *generative UI specs*: they describe what UI an agent wants to show. AG-UI is the *runtime protocol* that carries those payloads, along with everything else, between the agent and the app. [Learn more →](https://docs.ag-ui.com/concepts/generative-ui-specs) ## Integrations AG-UI is adopted by Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle, and built into most agent frameworks. Every framework below has a live demo in the [Dojo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com).

[Build an integration →](https://docs.ag-ui.com/quickstart/introduction) ### Full list of integrations
Show all integrations
- **Partners:** [LangChain](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/langgraph/) · [CrewAI](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/crewai-flows) - **Built in:** [Microsoft Agent Framework](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/microsoft-agent-framework) · [Google ADK](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/adk) ([JS](https://docs.ag-ui.com/integrations/google-adk-js)) · [Google Antigravity](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/google-antigravity) · [AWS Strands Agents](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/aws-strands) · [Mastra](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/mastra/) · [Pydantic AI](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/pydantic-ai/) · [Agno](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/agno/) · [LlamaIndex](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/llamaindex/) · [AG2](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/ag2/) - **More frameworks:** [Claude Agent SDK](integrations/claude-agent-sdk) · [Claude Managed Agents](integrations/claude-managed-agents) · [IBM watsonx Orchestrate](integrations/watsonx) · [Langroid](integrations/langroid) · [Spring AI](integrations/community/spring-ai) · [Cloudflare Agents](integrations/community/cloudflare-agents) · [Omnara](https://docs.ag-ui.com/integrations/omnara) · [Genkit (Go)](integrations/community/genkit/go) · [OpenAI Agents](integrations/openai-agents) - **Specs:** [Oracle Agent Spec](https://go.copilotkit.ai/copilotkit-oracle-docs) - **Deployment:** [Amazon Bedrock AgentCore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-agui.html) Source for every integration lives in [`integrations/`](integrations) and [`middlewares/`](middlewares), and the demos in [`apps/dojo`](apps/dojo).
## SDKs | Language | Install | Reference | | --- | --- | --- | | **TypeScript** | `npm install @ag-ui/client` | [Docs](https://docs.ag-ui.com/sdk/js/core/overview) · [Source](sdks/typescript) | | **Python** | `pip install ag-ui-protocol` | [Docs](https://docs.ag-ui.com/sdk/python/core/overview) · [Source](sdks/python) | | **.NET** | `dotnet add package AGUI.Client` | [Docs](https://docs.ag-ui.com/sdk/dotnet/client/overview) · [Source](sdks/dotnet) | **Community SDKs:** [Kotlin](sdks/community/kotlin) · [Go](sdks/community/go) · [Java](sdks/community/java) · [Dart](sdks/community/dart) · [Rust](sdks/community/rust) · [Ruby](sdks/community/ruby) · [C++](sdks/community/c++) · [Swift](sdks/community/swift) ## Features: what you can build Each building block maps to events in the spec, and each has a live demo in the [AG-UI Dojo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com). | Building block | What it does | Try it | | --- | --- | --- | | **Streaming chat** | Token-by-token messages across multi-turn sessions, with cancel and resume | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/agentic_chat) | | **Generative UI** | Agents render typed components, or declarative UI with [A2UI](https://github.com/google/A2UI) and MCP Apps | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/tool_based_generative_ui) | | **Shared state** | A typed store the agent and app both read and write, synced with snapshots and JSON Patch deltas | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/shared_state) | | **Frontend tools** | The agent calls tools that run in the app, and gets the result back | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/human_in_the_loop) | | **Human in the loop** | Runs end with an `interrupt` outcome; the user approves, edits, or rejects, and the next run resumes | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/mastra/feature/interrupt) | | **Reasoning** | Show the agent's reasoning as it works, including encrypted reasoning round-trips | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/agentic_chat_reasoning) | | **Subagents** | Nested delegation, with every event attributed to the subagent run that produced it | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/deepagents_subagents) | | **Multimodal** | Images, audio, video, and documents in user input and tool results | [Demo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/langgraph-fastapi/feature/agentic_chat_multimodal) | Tool output streaming, backend tool rendering, activity progress, token usage, and custom events are covered in the [docs](https://docs.ag-ui.com/concepts/events). Here's a quick tour of the Dojo: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c298eea8-3f39-4a94-b968-7712429b0c49 ## How it works ![Diagram of how AG-UI works: your app (CopilotKit, React, mobile, terminal, Slack or any client) sends a single RunAgentInput with messages, tools, state and context to your agent (LangChain, CrewAI, Mastra, Google ADK, Pydantic AI or any framework), and the agent streams back typed AG-UI events for lifecycle, text messages, tool calls, state, reasoning, activity, subagents, and custom and raw data, over any transport such as SSE, WebSockets or HTTP binary (Protobuf).](.github/readme/how-it-works.svg) Your app starts a run by sending the agent a single `RunAgentInput`: the conversation, the tools the frontend offers, shared state, and context. The agent answers with a stream of typed events from eight families: run lifecycle, text messages, tool calls, state, reasoning, activity, subagents, and custom events ([full list](#event-reference)). Only the run lifecycle is required, so a minimal agent emits a handful of events and grows from there. AG-UI is transport-agnostic. The spec defines [HTTP + SSE](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/basic/transports/http-sse) and a binary [HTTP + Protobuf](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/basic/transports/http-protobuf) binding, and middleware can adapt events from any source. Read the [architecture overview](https://docs.ag-ui.com/concepts/architecture) for the full picture. ## Event reference AG-UI 1.0 defines 31 event types in eight families. See the [spec](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events) for every field. | Event family | Events | | --- | --- | | [Runs and steps](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/lifecycle) | `RUN_STARTED` `RUN_FINISHED` `RUN_ERROR` `STEP_STARTED` `STEP_FINISHED` | | [Text messages](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/text-messages) | `TEXT_MESSAGE_START` `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` `TEXT_MESSAGE_END` `TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK` | | [Tool calls](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/tool-calls) | `TOOL_CALL_START` `TOOL_CALL_ARGS` `TOOL_CALL_END` `TOOL_CALL_RESULT` `TOOL_CALL_CHUNK` | | [State](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/state) | `STATE_SNAPSHOT` `STATE_DELTA` (JSON Patch) `MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT` | | [Reasoning](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/reasoning) | `REASONING_START` `REASONING_MESSAGE_*` `REASONING_ENCRYPTED_VALUE` `REASONING_END` | | [Activity](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/activity) | `ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT` `ACTIVITY_DELTA` | | [Subagents](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/subagents) | `SUBAGENT_STARTED` `SUBAGENT_FINISHED` `SUBAGENT_ERROR` | | [Passthrough](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/1.0/events/passthrough) | `RAW` `CUSTOM` | ## Community - **Questions and ideas:** [Discord](https://discord.gg/Jd3FzfdJa8) and [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui/discussions) - **Bugs:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui/issues) - **What's next:** the [roadmap](https://github.com/orgs/ag-ui-protocol/projects/1) and the [draft spec](https://docs.ag-ui.com/spec/draft) ## Contributing Contributions are welcome: new integrations, SDKs, docs, and fixes. Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and use the [server starter](integrations/server-starter) and [middleware starter](middlewares/middleware-starter) as templates for new integrations. Report security issues as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). AG-UI was created by [CopilotKit](https://copilotkit.ai) and is developed in the open with the community. ## License AG-UI is open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
